items.title: Address one robot a group or the whole swarm

reported.user_action: select an individual group or whole swarm then indicate motion speed or scale
reported.semantic_action: select and move at chosen granularity
reported.controlled_quantity: group motion; speed; selection; formation scale

reconstruction.summary: Reconstruct target scope as a policy decision that remains separate from the physical input route.
reconstruction.interaction: toggle member group and all scopes then issue the same move or speed command
reconstruction.effect: identical semantic commands affect different population scopes
reconstruction.transfer_boundary: elicited mappings are contextual and do not establish an implemented universal vocabulary or ability-diverse usability
reconstruction.does_not_claim: This reconstruction does not reproduce the elicited gestures or establish a universal or ability-diverse interaction vocabulary.

reported.input_expression: smartphone motion and spiral gesture through a web interface
reported.input_routes: continuous device motion plus persistent gesture event
reported.user_action: move the phone to exert gravity or draw a spiral to place a persistent point
reported.semantic_action: apply gravitational attractor or repellent field
reported.controlled_quantity: gravitational forces and persistent attractors or repellents
reported.multi_user_combination: field superposition from up to eight players

reconstruction.summary: Reconstruct additive personal attractor and repellent fields while retaining contributor provenance.

reconstruction.effect: particle trajectories bend under the additive fields and retain visible contributor colours
reconstruction.transfer_boundary: no statistical user study fairness accessibility agency or optimal overlap policy

items.title: Adjust transition rates inside the swarm controller

reported.input_routes: exact physical device not reported in the source note
reported.user_action: adjust rates governing transitions among robot states
reported.controlled_quantity: rates of transitions among robot states

reconstruction.summary: Reconstruct app-owned rates for entering Flock, Cohere, and Disperse modes, and expose their distribution and metrics as a technical analogy.
reconstruction.interaction: move labelled state-transition sliders while a state-flow diagram remains visible
reconstruction.effect: the proportions of agents occupying exploration task or other states change over time
reconstruction.transfer_boundary: technical plausibility only; no completed usability fairness or shared-authorship evaluation
reconstruction.does_not_claim: This reconstruction does not reproduce the source's exploration, task, or other robot-state model or instrument, and demonstrates technical parameter effects rather than evaluated usability, fairness, or shared authorship.

items.title: Translate Laban movement qualities into swarm dynamics

reported.input_expression: described camera and MediaPipe body-pose pipeline; reported study used pre-rendered clips
reported.user_action: move or set Space Time Weight and Flow qualities
reported.semantic_action: translate expressive qualities into coupled motion parameters
reported.controlled_quantity: Laban Space; Time; Weight; Flow mapped to alignment; separation; cohesion; speed; randomness; damping; jitter

reconstruction.summary: Reconstruct semantically labelled movement qualities through transparent app-owned qualitative interpolation into one inspectable raw swarm-parameter vector.
reconstruction.interaction: use semantic sliders with an expandable panel showing every raw parameter change
reconstruction.effect: particles visibly change trajectory speed compactness randomness damping and jitter
reconstruction.transfer_boundary: recognition was evaluated on rendered clips; live input multi-user combination accessibility agency and authorship were not evaluated
reconstruction.does_not_claim: This app-owned qualitative mapping is not the authors' runtime or a validated universal Laban interpreter; the reported evaluation used rendered clips and did not evaluate live control, multi-user control, accessibility, agency, or authorship.

items.title: Split merge and rescale a swarm

reported.user_action: indicate split merge or formation-size change

reconstruction.summary: Reconstruct deterministic split and merge operations over explicit canonical member groups, plus an independently bounded formation-scale target.
reconstruction.interaction: select split merge or scale and optionally choose affected groups
reconstruction.effect: one collective becomes several groups reunites or changes formation extent
reconstruction.transfer_boundary: elicitation evidence does not establish implemented morphology control multi-user governance or universal gestures
reconstruction.does_not_claim: These deterministic partition, canonical-identity, and formation-scale rules are app-owned; this reconstruction does not establish implemented morphology control in the source, multi-user governance, validated accessibility, or universal gestures.

items.title: Acquire expire and hand off a per-robot lease

source.source_locus: Sections III-D through III-F and IV-VI

reported.input_routes: exact controller or hand action not extracted
reported.user_action: select a robot acquire its lease hand it off or wait for expiry
reported.controlled_quantity: per-robot control ownership; lease expiry; handoff
reported.target_scope: one robot within a three-robot team
reported.multi_user_combination: exclusive per-robot lease and explicit handoff

reconstruction.summary: Reconstruct exclusive per-member control leases with visible acquisition, expiry, release, and handoff.
reconstruction.interaction: use two operator panels to request grant release and expire one member's lease
reconstruction.effect: ownership badges and enabled commands move between operators without blending commands
reconstruction.transfer_boundary: fully simulated centrally supervised three-robot system without endogenous swarm dynamics or mixed-ability design
reconstruction.does_not_claim: This reconstruction does not reproduce the mixed-reality system or establish endogenous swarm dynamics, mixed-ability access, or equitable authority.

items.title: Save retrieve and reset collective state

reported.user_action: store retrieve or reset a canvas state
reported.semantic_action: activate saved global state or whole-canvas reset
reported.controlled_quantity: five saved canvas states; whole-canvas reset
reported.multi_user_combination: shared global memory and reset; no per-user provenance

reconstruction.summary: Use save, retrieve, reset, and deterministic replay as atlas-wide history infrastructure.
reconstruction.interaction: create named checkpoints retrieve one or issue a visible reset
reconstruction.effect: collective state returns to a stored snapshot while the event history remains visible in the reconstruction
reconstruction.transfer_boundary: whole-canvas memory only; no selective undo branching per-person provenance or participant-outcome evidence
reconstruction.does_not_claim: This reconstruction does not reproduce the robotic canvas or establish selective undo, branching, per-person provenance, or participant outcomes.
